name: Nexus Fulcrum Lateral
monitor_reason: Cannot yet tell whether the plant lateral is the same pipe as the Tahoe Reno Industrial Center spur in the Great Basin 2028 Expansion (P7860). Staging it could duplicate P7860. The tie to data centers is established, so this is not a threshold failure.
researcher_notes: The data center tie is solid. A June 17, 2026 application to the Public Utilities Commission of Nevada, reported by the Nevada Independent and New Project Media, asks to build a 510 megawatt gas plant at the edge of the Tahoe Reno Industrial Center. The application says the plant is needed to support expanded development there, including data centers. New Project Media says gas would come through a new lateral connecting to the Great Basin Pipeline system. Neither article names a lateral builder, length, route, or diameter. Two data center operators are involved at the park, but who is developing the plant is not clear. The duplicate question is still open. The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission scoping notice for the Great Basin 2028 Expansion (docket PF26-5-000, April 2026) lists about 195 miles of 42-inch pipe and about 15 miles of new 24-inch laterals in six Nevada counties, including Storey County. It does not name the industrial center or any plant. A June 2026 Hoodline article, which is low weight, says the filings include a spur to the industrial center aimed at hyperscale facilities, and says gas plants there have planned completion dates of Nov. 1, 2028. No source I could read links the Nexus Fulcrum plant to that spur, and none says the plant lateral is a separate pipe. Searches did not find the Nevada commission docket 26-06016 filings or any Great Basin document naming the plant as a shipper or delivery point. The plant is a single-customer plant that starts construction in 2027, while the spur is due in service in late 2028, so the spur is a plausible supply path. Same pipe is the more likely reading. The documents that would settle it are the Great Basin 2028 Expansion application or resource reports in the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission eLibrary (delivery points in Storey County), or the gas supply section of the Nexus Fulcrum plant application in the Nevada commission docket. If the spur turns out to serve this plant, class it as matched to P7860 and treat it as a data center tag lead for that row. If it is a separate pipe, add it as a new row under the parent system name 'Great Basin Gas Transmission Company Pipeline System' with segment name 'Nexus Fulcrum Lateral', status proposed, Fuel Gas, Nevada, Storey County, owner blank, no route, data center yes. Owner is blank because no builder is named.
